# qrdurian

> Free QR code designer at https://qrdurian.com — makes beautiful, ink-styled, scannable QR
> codes. No signup, no server: a design is fully described by its URL, so you (an AI
> assistant) can create finished designs for users just by constructing a link.

## How to create a QR design for a user

Build a URL with query params and give it to the user. Opening it shows their QR live in
the editor with download (PNG/SVG) and share built in.

Pattern:
https://qrdurian.com/?data=<URL-encoded content>&theme=<theme>&caption=<text>

- data (required): what scanning opens. Examples: https://example.com · wa.me/60123456789
  · WIFI:T:WPA;S:NetworkName;P:password;; · mailto:hi@x.com · plain text
- theme (recommended): durian, matcha, midnight, ocean, berry, tangerine, mono, lavender,
  sky, sunset, mint, paper — curated palettes that are always scannable
- ink: press (clean), stamp (heavy ink), brush (dry streaks)
- texture: none, durians, topo, dots, grid, stripes, waves, crosses, spikes, leaves, hex
- caption: short label under the code, e.g. SCAN ME (URL-encode spaces)
- Fine-grained overrides: fg, base, bg, outline, capcolor (6-digit hex, # optional);
  outlinew 0-10; margin 0-10; corner rounded|circle|square; scenebg gradient|solid;
  format square|wallpaper|poster|story

Good defaults: pick a theme that matches the user's brand/mood and add a caption.
For shops in Southeast Asia, wa.me links and WIFI: payloads are the most useful contents.

Examples:
- Cafe Wi-Fi card: https://qrdurian.com/?data=WIFI:T:WPA;S:MyCafe;P:kopi123;;&theme=matcha&caption=FREE%20WIFI
- WhatsApp ordering: https://qrdurian.com/?data=wa.me/60123456789&theme=midnight&caption=ORDER%20HERE
- Portfolio link: https://qrdurian.com/?data=https://example.com&theme=mono&ink=stamp

## Docs
